grammar_title: 将来进行时(The Future Progressive: will be doing)
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 2 Discover useful structures:将来进行时(will be doing)。句子地道、含明确将来时间标志,使将来进行时唯一成立;干扰项 will do / is doing / will have done / has done 同时间家族,只有将来进行时合适。

points.point: 表将来某一时刻正在进行(this time tomorrow / at 8 pm tonight)
points.overview: 带明确将来时间点(this time next year / at 9 am tomorrow)时,表示届时正在进行的动作,用 will be doing。

points.point: 表预计必将发生 / 委婉询问(I'll be seeing him soon / Will you be using it?)
points.overview: 表示按计划或自然趋势必将发生的将来动作,或委婉地询问对方安排,用 will be doing。

points.point: 与一般将来时 will do / 现在进行时 is doing 对照,凸显'将来进行'
points.overview: 在同一将来时间框架下,与表'单纯将来'的 will do、'眼下正进行'的 is doing 等对比,题干的将来时间状语决定只能用 will be doing。

questions.stem: This time tomorrow, I ____ on a plane to the future technology fair.
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow 指明将来某一时刻正在进行 → will be flying。

questions.stem: At 8 pm tonight, the family ____ dinner cooked by their new robot.
questions.explanation: at 8 pm tonight 为将来时间点,届时动作进行中 → will be having。

questions.stem: Compare these: tomorrow he ____ a robot, but right now he just dreams of it.
questions.explanation: tomorrow 强调将来某刻进行中,对照'眼下'的现在进行 → will be building。
